column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Arabic video-editing vocabulary (مقطع، مسار، تسلسل، رأس التشغيل، حاوية…). No proprietary
# localization resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same
# way. Menu commands use the verbal noun (إضافة، حفظ، إزالة…). Product, format and technology names
# (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, EDL, AAF, GitHub, Discord…) keep their Latin spelling.
# This catalog has the same entries as `es.tsv`; strings added later show in English until they are
# translated. Arabic is right-to-left: it needs an Arabic-capable font and text shaping to display
# correctly. A native-speaker review is welcome.

Media that is already open keeps its decoder until it is reopened.
